repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-metrics
repository.purpose: Internal Webex SDK plugin that collects, enriches, batches and submits every SDK-owned telemetry family — legacy client metrics, tagged behavioral/operational/business events, Call Analyzer diagnostic events, WebRTC stats, browser unhandled exceptions and SDK network-request summaries — to the Webex metrics and unified-telemetry services.

public_interfaces.name: package-entry
public_interfaces.audience: Sibling Webex JS SDK workspace packages and first party clients
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers both internal plugins; the named export list in src/index.ts is the published surface.

public_interfaces.name: event-types
public_interfaces.audience: Consumers typing their own event payloads
public_interfaces.notes: Derived from the externally owned @webex/event-dictionary-ts schema pinned in package.json.

public_interfaces.name: npm-scripts
public_interfaces.notes: The package test script is not a working gate: it chains test:integration and test:browser, which are not defined.

validate_with: spec-drift-changed over the changed source files and their owning module spec

generated_artifacts.refresh_with: Re-run Repo Annotation template setup against the bundled Repo Standards snapshot

minimum: human review against the cited source paths
recommended: spec-drift-changed for the affected module spec

affects: Seven dependent workspace packages that import the plugin surface or its types
change_impact.notes: Removing or renaming an export is breaking for the monorepo; land consumers in the same change.

affects: Submitted payload shapes consumed by Webex metrics, Call Analyzer and unified telemetry ingestion
change_impact.notes: Payload field removals or renames break ingestion; update the owning module spec's Protocol and wire format section.

affects: The pinned Call Analyzer event schema

glossary.definition: A Call Analyzer diagnostic event describing a client-side call milestone or failure.
A behavioral, operational or business metric built as a metric name plus tags.
glossary.notes: Contrast with a Call Analyzer envelope; see src/generic-metrics.ts.

glossary.definition: A caller-supplied identifier that attributes telemetry before sign-in, sent as a header on the unauthenticated resource.
The accumulation period after which a collector submits one aggregate and resets.

evidence_rules.requirement: A command must exist in package.json scripts and match .sdd/manifest.json.
An exported name must appear in src/index.ts.
Cite the implementing source file and, for verified behavior, a test that exercises it.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history is not acceptable evidence for this package.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat the package test script as a working gate.
negative_guidance.why: It chains test:integration and test:browser, which this package does not define.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not hand-declare Call Analyzer event names or fields.
negative_guidance.why: They are owned by @webex/event-dictionary-ts and derived in src/metrics.types.ts.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not cite commit history as rationale.
negative_guidance.why: The owner declared history untrustworthy as evidence; derive why from code and tests.

high.expectation: The claim is backed by a cited source file and, for behavior, a test that exercises it.

medium.expectation: Source evidence exists but no test pins it; document the behavior and record the coverage gap.

low.expectation: Neither source nor test supports the claim; stop and report the gap rather than inferring it.

main_entrypoints.name: package-entry
main_entrypoints.purpose: Registers the metrics and newMetrics internal plugins and defines the export surface.

workspace_packages.name: @webex/internal-plugin-metrics
workspace_packages.notes: One workspace package of the webex-js-sdk monorepo; it is the SDD root.

source_surfaces.name: plugin-root
source_surfaces.notes: Registration, both facades, batchers, tagged events and network telemetry.

source_surfaces.name: call-diagnostic
source_surfaces.notes: Call Analyzer events and the latency ledger.

generated_surfaces.name: build-output
generated_surfaces.notes: Git-ignored; produced per build and published to npm.

generated_surfaces.name: repo-standards-templates
generated_surfaces.refresh_with: Re-run Repo Annotation template setup against the bundled Repo Standards snapshot
generated_surfaces.notes: A symlink to the monorepo-root template set, so this package holds no template copies of its own.

sync_paths.mechanism: Repo Annotation template setup, resolved from the bundled checksum-verified snapshot
sync_paths.notes: Reached through the symlink to the monorepo root; never seeded per package.

validation_entrypoints.name: unit
validation_entrypoints.scope: All unit specs under test/unit/spec/; accepts --targets relative to that directory.

surface_owners.edit_boundary: Behavioral changes must update the owning module spec and the unit suite in the same change.
Module specs are protected canonical specs; changes go through spec reconciliation rather than in-place overwrite.
Owner-authored npm landing page; not generated and never rewritten by documentation tooling.

fallback_rules: When a command role has no committed command, record it as needing human input rather than inventing one.
When source and the package README disagree, follow the source and record the README statement as stale.
When a behavior has no test, document it and record the coverage gap instead of asserting it is verified.
